title: Router v1 teacher-forced pre-softmax logit summary

status.description: ok requires that the teacher-forced sampled-token logprobs reproduce the archived pass-1 trace within the registered tolerance.

positions.description: One entry per pass-1 content token, in generation order. Full vocabulary logits are never stored: max_logit and logsumexp are jointly sufficient for every registered feature, since log p(sampled) = max_logit - logsumexp under greedy decoding.

identity_max_abs_error.description: max over positions of |sampled_logprob - (max_logit - logsumexp)|. Must be at or below the contract's 1e-4 tolerance for status ok. A larger value means the capture is not the distribution that produced the archived output, and the record must be rejected rather than reported.

archive_max_abs_error.description: max over positions of |recomputed sampled_logprob - the logprob archived by pass 1|. identity_max_abs_error checks that decoding was greedy; this checks that the teacher-forced pass reproduces the ORIGINAL run. Both must hold for status ok: the first alone would pass on a correctly-greedy forward over the wrong weights or the wrong prompt rendering.

description: Recovers the pre-softmax logit scale that a log-probability discards. It needs no regeneration: pass 1 ran greedily at temperature 0, so the archived output is the decoding path and a single teacher-forced forward pass over prompt + raw_output sees exactly the distribution each token was drawn from.
